description: Shai-Hulud npm worm (Sept 2025) — postinstall script harvested and exfiltrated developer credentials (npm tokens, cloud keys) from compromised packages in the tinycolor supply-chain attack.
Compromised maintainer-account publish (Sept 2025) injected a Windows-targeted malicious install script into eslint-config-prettier releases.
npm account phishing compromise (Sept 2025) published a malicious chalk release with a crypto-clipper payload targeting browser wallet traffic.
npm account phishing compromise (Sept 2025) — the widely-depended-on `debug` package was published with the same crypto-clipper payload as the chalk incident.
